blurb: Guests can rent American-made row and pedal boats hourly to explore Golden Gate Park's lake and sights including the Blue Heron Bridge and local wildlife. The boathouse also offers a variety of dining options from coffee to local wine and food items like hamburgers and salads. Event spaces are available for work events, weddings, and parties.
